subject: MetaPose kickoff — multi-camera 3D pose without calibration
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off MetaPose productization. The differentiator: our published MetaPose model estimates 3D human pose from multiple cameras with unknown calibration, trains on 2D keypoint data only, and beats both classical bundle adjustment and weakly-supervised monocular baselines on Human3.6M and the harder in-the-wild Ski-Pose PTZ set. Two prospective internal customers: the sports-analysis demo team and the robotics lab's motion-capture-free evaluation rig — both have multi-camera setups nobody ever calibrates properly.

Milestones (window through 06-15):
- 04-10: released checkpoints + data reproducing paper metrics in our eval harness.
- 05-15: latency-optimized inference path; the "minimal latency overhead" claim quantified on our hardware.
- 06-08: pilot on the robotics lab's 4-camera rig with occlusion-heavy scenes.

Daniela owns staffing; Linnea is TL. Q3 continuation planning will come up mid-window — this one won't finish at the pilot.

Lucia
